underlying_earlier_sources.parent_frozen_research_context: All 16 are previously exposed development groups of same broad TCEC ecology, not new independent validation. P1 four-game procedural holdout remains untouched.

arm_A_joint_nodes_completedDepth.design: N0 from prior CLEAN SF16 depth12 original root node report, caps floor(.8N0), N0, ceil(1.2N0), each all 16 groups, OFF/MAIN and two cold restarts, Threads1 Hash16MiB MultiPV2, real SF16 source-native post-search bestThread->completedDepth.
arm_A_joint_nodes_completedDepth.posttreatment_node_discrepancy_near_crit: absolute actual reported nodes difference over maximum reported nodes <= 0.02, and actual source-native completedDepth equal. Not a causal direct effect after conditioning on mediator.
limits: Native completedDepth is not UCI last printed PV depth, which previously mismatched in 46/64 tests.
Equal requested node cap does not mean exact achieved work or depth.
Comparing arms conditional on achieved completedDepth/nodes is posttreatment conditioning; no pure TT direct effect is identified.
No independent provider/engine, chess concept causation or human learning efficacy is proven.

arm_B_legally_reached_concept_source_onl.sources_of_confounding: Different black legal move changes full tactical configuration, piece activity, sometimes NNUE, source Zobrist position and search move ordering, rather than isolating a single chess concept.

arm_B_actual_engine_intervention.world_design: PLAYED_HISTORY 16 + CONCEPT_CHANGE_HISTORY 14 + CONCEPT_SHAM_HISTORY 14 + PLAYED_FEN_ONLY 16, all game history paths exact to black 18th move, alternative FEN-only history dropped negative control; root pair same legal one/double white pawn advances.
arm_B_actual_engine_intervention.note: No observed effect of dropping history at this depth/set; no claim general history irrelevance.

posthoc_paired_absolute_change_compariso.note: Exploratory post-outcome tabulation, not preregistered independent causal contrast test.

arm_B_actual_engine_intervention.interpretation: Chess-domain opponent capture/pawn-attack contrast change did NOT show preferentially larger native TT response under this frozen legal-last-move comparator than measured concept-preserving sham. Therefore no isolated pawn-concept causal mediator is identified; competing tactics, full positional state, NNUE, TT keys, move order and work remain unresolved.

forward_inference_and_experiment.next_test: Build source-native event-level attribution of TT insertion/lookup provenance, alternative TT collision + move-order + NNUE + alpha-beta/reduction workload explanations. Seek real chess minimal contrast with invariant immediate tactical alternatives, preserve full history and exact engine transcript; test separate independent engine and fresh-provider source only with upfront commitment.
